title: FIX: "Achievements cannot be earned in this world" (Works in 2 Min)
topic: Kya aapne galti se apne Minecraft Survival World mein Creative mode on kar diya?
description: Kya aapne galti se apne Minecraft Survival World mein Creative mode on kar diya? Kya ab aapko "Achievements cannot be earned in this world" ka error aa raha hai? Ghabraiye mat! Is video mein main aapko ek aisi 'Forbidden Trick' dikhaunga jisse aap apne purane world ki achievements phir se ON kar sakte hain! IMPORTANT FOR iOS/iPad PLAYERS: Agar aap iPhone use kar rahe hain, toh aapko files access karne mein Android 13/14 jaisi koi problem nahi aayegi. Apple ne Minecraft files
